title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - LoadControlEventData
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/LoadControlEventData. An event used to send overload warning severity level and related load control commands to a device (e.g. a household appliance or a smart meter).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LoadControlEventData'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasTimestamp.description: Property. The time the load control event information instance was created or received.

hasDevice.description: Relationship. A relationship between a load control event (used to send overload warning severity level and related load control commands) and the device interested by this event. Relationship to Device.

triggersEventActionConsume.description: Property. A relationship between a load control event and the consume action triggered by this event Controlled vocabulary (EventActionConsume).

triggersEventActionProduce.description: Property. A relationship between a load control event and the produce action triggered by this event Controlled vocabulary (EventActionProduce).

hasIdentifier.description: Property. A unique identifier for this load control event.
